Grill arrived promptly and was packaged well. It was a bit tedious to assemble but instructions were easy to follow. Took about two hours total to do by myself at a leisurely pace. Unfortunately, the parts package was one bolt, nut, and washer short which was frustrating. I left it off a non critical part but don’t know how to obtain the extra part from Weber and likely need to go to the hardware store to get a replacement on my own. 

After several uses the grill is operating very well. Easy to start and nice even cooking. I look forward to it lasting for many years.

Spirit II E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: Great grill, easy assembly, clear instructions, quality hardware and one of the best warranties in the industry. Coming from a big box store value leader grill to this Weber was a welcome improvement. The Weber cooks evenly and the grates and burners are excellent quality. My only slightly negative comment about the Weber is the inability to get a good sear on some meats. It just doesn’t have the heat output so if you are looking for a grill with the ability to burn in those grate lines try a different model. If you want a well built grill with a great warranty at an affordable price the the Series 2 is a good choice. If you like saving money buy one from a big box store at the end of the season as they typically offer discounts.
Results.Title: Quality Grill

Results.ReviewText:
I bought the Spirit II E-310. The assembly booklet was most helpful. The illustrations and step by step instructions are spot on and easy to follow. I enjoyed assembling this grill. I must mention that it was expertly packaged, very smart how it all fit in the box. It went together without a problem. The framework is sturdy and well built. The in-lid thermometer is helpful, no guessing at the temperature. The grates are heavy duty and I can get good grill marks on the food. For the two of us, the cooking surface is more than adequate. The gas tank is easy to hang which is over the wheels. I've used our new grill a couple dozen times and I'm pleased with the results. I'm still learning but there seems to be a "hot spot" along the back of the unit but that's no big deal. 

P.S. Not everything needs an app ... 😉
Results.Title: Grill Marks Galore

ClientResponses.Response:
Your feedback means a lot to us. We are very sorry to hear your hose and regulator is leaking. We are here to help. 

In almost every case of reported leaks, the rubber gasket on the inside of the propane tank nozzle is oval in shape, as opposed to round, is cracked or is otherwise compromised, and therefore results in a leak. The gasket should be perfectly round, with no nicks or cracks.
 
Be sure to visually inspect that all the burners are extinguished (No Flame Present) 

Our Care team will reach out to follow up with you. Please look for an outreach from us soon. Thank you!

Results.ReviewText:
I have owned a Weber Grill which I bought many years ago. Couldn't beat the craftmanship.
Just bought this new one and the quality was vastly different. For one thing the gas regulator leaked from the get go and had to be replaced(luckily it was under warranty or it would have cost $58.00). Still, the replacement gas regulator was of the same poor quality. One would think that, this regulator, bring the heart of the grill would be manufactured much better not only for use but because it could cause a catastrophe if it caused a fire. I should have checked if it was UL certified but didn't. Oh well, my bad.
Results.Title: Not as well made as they once were

With the spacious cooking area you can sear steaks on one side while grilling an appetizer on the other, and the convenient open-cart allows you to keep your tools and equipment within reach. Armed with the strong GS4 grilling system, this gas grill is sure to take you and your meals to the next level.
